tools.name: build_image_url
tools.title: Build Motomarks Image CDN URL
tools.description: Build a deterministic Motomarks image CDN URL authenticated with the caller's publishable key.

tools.name: complete_sign_up
tools.title: Complete Motomarks sign-up
tools.description: Verify the six-digit email code from sign_up. Creates the account when the email is new, then returns API keys so the client can reconnect as that user.

email.description: The same email address passed to sign_up.

code.description: Six-digit verification code from the email.

tools.name: describe_api_endpoint
tools.title: Describe Motomarks API Endpoint
tools.description: Return the HTTP endpoint, auth mode, params, and example for a Motomarks REST operation.

operation.description: The Motomarks API operation to describe.

tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Get Motomarks Account
tools.description: Get the authenticated caller's Motomarks account: plan, attribution status, today's API usage against the daily limit, and active API keys (secret keys masked).

tools.name: get_brand
tools.title: Get Motomarks Brand
tools.description: Get full details for a published Motomarks brand by slug: description, colors, palette, social links, company facts, FAQs, and optionally its assets.

includeAssets.description: Also include a compact asset summary.

tools.name: list_brand_assets
tools.title: List Motomarks Brand Assets
tools.description: List available Motomarks logo assets for a brand and optionally include generated CDN image URLs.

includeCdnUrls.description: Include generated CDN URLs for webp/png assets.

tools.name: search_brands
tools.title: Search Motomarks Brands
tools.description: Search published Motomarks brands by name, company, or slug. Optionally filter by vehicle type and include ready-to-use CDN image URLs.

query.description: Brand name, company name, or slug to search for.

vehicleType.description: Filter to brands that include this vehicle type (or any of these types).

limit.description: Maximum number of brands to return.

includeImageUrls.description: Include generated CDN image URLs for each brand.

type.description: Logo variant for generated CDN image URLs.

format.description: Image format for generated CDN URLs.

size.description: Image size for generated CDN URLs.

aspect.description: Image aspect ratio for generated CDN URLs.

tools.name: sign_up
tools.title: Sign up for Motomarks
tools.description: Create a free Motomarks account or start sign-in for an existing email. Sends a six-digit verification code. No password or credit card. After the user reads the code, call complete_sign_up.

email.description: Email address that will own the Motomarks account.

resources.name: image-cdn-docs
resources.title: Motomarks Image CDN
resources.description: CDN URL format and query parameters for Motomarks brand images.

resources.name: api-v1-docs
resources.title: Motomarks API v1
resources.description: Motomarks API v1 auth and endpoint summary.

prompts.name: create_motomarks_account
prompts.title: Create Motomarks Account
prompts.description: Walk a user through creating a free Motomarks account from this MCP session.

prompts.name: find_brand_logo
prompts.title: Find Brand Logo
prompts.description: Guide an agent through finding a Motomarks brand logo and selecting an asset variant.

prompts.name: embed_brand_image
prompts.title: Embed Brand Image
prompts.description: Create HTML, React, or Markdown snippets using a Motomarks CDN URL.
